comment:
Two things on this module cannot be reached. An End of cycle output is configured at Circles.cpp:297 and written every sample at Circles.cpp:939, pulsing 1ms whenever the sequence returns to step 1, but no jack is added for it. A Scale chain length parameter is configured at Circles.cpp:255 and is still read at Circles.cpp:318, but only to convert older patches the first time they are opened (Circles.cpp:342-349); the four Include buttons replaced it and no widget exists for it. Neither appears in the manual's list.

The Flow CV input overrides the Flow knob rather than offsetting it (Circles.cpp:393-395), at 2.5V per position.

The manual says 'Button and trigger changes wait for a full eight-step cycle before becoming active'. That applies to Dice alone (Circles.cpp:682, 817-818, 838-839). Step enables, scale includes and the Next input all take effect immediately.

The manual says the accent output is configurable; it is not. Accent is fixed to steps 1 and 5 and is only produced when those steps are enabled (Circles.cpp:827).

The Gate knob is used twice, against different lengths: for the main gate it is a fraction of one step, and for the sub gate a fraction of one bar (Circles.cpp:310-315, 809-813), so the same setting gives a much longer sub gate.

Selecting a different scale slot with the sub track's SCALE control writes the stored step back into the STEP parameter (Circles.cpp:517-520), so that knob moves on its own when SCALE is turned.

The eight step knobs, their enable buttons and the step CV jacks are all real ParamWidgets and PortWidgets, so each can be clicked; the central display is one custom widget and cannot.
